data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Jasvant carries deep spiritual meaning. It is believed that the divine brings victory and success in one's spiritual journey. The name is a reminder that one's inner strength and connection to God can help overcome any obstacle or challenge, and lead to spiritual enlightenment and inner peace. historical_references.reference: Jasvant was a famous Jain Tirthankara of the 12th Jain Tirthankara cycle, known as the Siddhantakala. He is believed to have lived approximately between 372-361 BCE.

Jasvant is also mentioned in various Indian literary works, including the 11th century Jain text, 'Parishishtaparvan'. He is described as a ruler of a small kingdom in the region of Rajasthan and is believed to have renounced his royal duties and become an ascetic.
